title: Officials asked whether he had a mental connection to the triangle

tellings.quote: when I came forward, they were very interested if I had a connection to the triangle.

plain: When Dylan Borland came forward with his account, officials wanted to know whether he had a mental connection to "the triangle" at the heart of his story, he says. Borland, a guest who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, tells Michels that "they were very interested if I had a connection to the triangle." If so, officials were treating the idea of a mind linked to the object as something worth checking.
